==English==

===Pronunciation===
* {{audio|en|En-au-track down.ogg|a=AU}}

===Verb===
{{en-verb|*}}

# {{lb|en|idiomatic}} To [[hunt]] for or [[locate]]; to [[search]] for; to [[find]].
#: {{ux|en|I need to '''track down''' a computer so I can check my e-mails.}}
# {{&lit|en|track|down}}
#: {{ux|en|She'll '''track''' him '''down''' the mountain and catch him before long.}}
#: {{ux|en|The hurricane '''tracked down''' past the cape before blowing east.}}
#: {{ux|en|The cameraman '''tracked''' the plane '''down''' so we have a recording of the crash.}}
